summary.text: Josh Williams is a member of the Ohio House of Representatives for District 44 in Lucas County. He is an attorney who also teaches at Adrian College.

paragraphs.text: Williams dropped out of high school to work and support his young son, and was disabled for six years after falling 30 feet on the job.
After getting his GED, he started college at age 30 and graduated from law school by age 35.

He earned his juris doctorate from the University of Toledo College of Law and teaches constitutional law, criminal law, and criminal procedure in Adrian College's undergraduate criminal justice programs.
As a state representative, he is pursuing reform in workforce development, education, and criminal justice.
